description.value: Kool Treat is a beloved ice cream stand on the Crowsnest Highway at Christina Lake, billed as a local tradition. It serves cyclists and travellers passing through with outdoor terrace seating, vegan-friendly options, and accepts both cash and cards. Its location on a major touring route makes it a natural warm-weather pit stop.
